name: Therese van Maanen
description: Th – r – se van Maanen, Psychologist, Certified RLT Couples Therapist, Relational Life Therapist++ (Advanced Certification) I work with couples who want to move beyond recurring conflict, distance, resentment or painful, repeating patterns. I offer a warm, active and direct space where both partners feel understood, focusing on what happens between you, not who is right. We identify the protective patterns that keep you disconnected, explore how family history, gender, power, culture and neurodivergence shape your relationship, and practise new ways of relating in real time.

name: Dr Fiona Waddell
title: Psychologist
description: Fiona is an experienced clinical psychologist with more than 20 years of experience in private practice working with individuals, couples and families presenting with a broad range of symptoms and concerns. She has completed a clinical doctorate and has previous experience in a range of public mental health settings. These include CBT, ACT and trauma therapies including EMDR.
specialties: Sexual difficulties, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, EMDR

name: Dr Sara Partow
title: Psychologist
description: I am a clinical psychologist with a PhD in Clinical Psychology. I am passionate about providing a transformative and healing space, where you can feel cared for and begin to build a fulfilled life.
specialties: Sexual difficulties, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Schema Therapy, EMDR

name: Megan Jurecka
title: Psychologist
description: I am a psychologist with over 10 years experience working in mental health. We are wired to connect; but difficult childhood experiences can cause us to connect at the expense of emotional needs. With the momentum of post-traumatic growth, I believe we can all improve our perspectives and circumstances, inching ever closer to more genuine and meaningful life.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Sex worker issues, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Natalie O'Connor
title: Psychologist
description: With over 15 years in the field of mental health, Natalie’s therapeutic style as a clinical psychologist is warm, patient-centred and purposeful. The treatment frameworks Natalie largely draw from include Intensive Short-Term Dynamic Psychotherapy (ISTDP) and Schema-based therapies. Areas of special interest include relationship difficulties, single-incident and complex traumas, and women's health, including perinatal and menopausal transitions.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sex worker issues, Sexual abuse, Schema Therapy

name: Catherine McPhee
title: Psychologist
description: Kate is a registered psychologist with over twenty years of experience working with a diverse range of clients. She holds a Master of Counselling Psychology and is currently undertaking further training in Clinical Psychology. Kate is trained in evidence-based therapies, including Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (CBT), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) and Schema Therapy.
specialties: Sex worker issues, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Fiona Lange
title: Psychologist
description: Fiona works at the Blue Gum Centre for Psychology and Psychotherapy, in Croydon, VIC, where she provides EMDR therapy for individuals with post-trauma syndromes. SHE IS CURRENTLY TAKING REFERRALS. Her areas of interest include post-traumatic growth, the treatment or phobias, and EMDR.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Partners/families of sex offenders, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sex worker issues, Sexual abuse, Schema Therapy, EMDR
